question: If $\text{adj}(A) = \begin{pmatrix} 1 & 2 & 0 \\ -3 & 4 & 1 \\ 2 & 0 & 5 \end{pmatrix}$, what is the order of $A$?
explanation:
The adjugate matrix $\text{adj}(A)$ has order $3 \times 3$.
The adjugate of a matrix always has the same order as the original matrix.
Therefore, the order of $A$ is $3$.
